description: Core capability for the main window. App-defined pty_*/mirror_*/fs_* commands are accessible without ACL entries; this grants only the Tauri core defaults plus the plugin permissions the renderer actually invokes (zoom, updater check, relaunch, agent-attention desktop notifications) and the window commands the custom (frameless) title bar drives. The native folder picker runs Rust-side via `pick_project_dir` (app.dialog()), which isn't gated by a webview ACL, so the dialog plugin needs no capability entry here.
